users.subtitle: Administrators manage the platform; regular users work inside the knowledge bases they are granted.
users.confirmDelete: Delete this account? Their API keys and grants are revoked too.
users.initialPasswordHint: Give this to the user directly. They must change it at first sign-in, so it is a handover credential rather than one you keep.

grants.title: Permissions — {name}
grants.effectiveHint: What the system actually evaluates, after role-implied capabilities and implication (kb:manage satisfies kb:read).
grants.heldHint: The individual rows that were written down. Revoke one of these to remove access.

keys.title: API keys
keys.subtitle: How Agents and applications authenticate to the retrieval API.
keys.name: Name
keys.allOwnerKbs: All knowledge bases the owner can reach
keys.knowledgeBasesHint: Leave blank to cover every knowledge base the owner can reach — the key then narrows automatically as their access does.
keys.scopesHint: A key can never exceed its owner's own permissions; the intersection is recomputed on every request.
keys.confirmRevoke: Revoke this key? It stops working immediately across every replica.
keys.keyHint: Store this in your secret manager now. Only its hash is kept, so it cannot be shown again.
keys.intersectionExplainer: A key's effective permissions are the intersection of its scopes with its owner's permissions, recomputed at every request. Revoking a user's access therefore narrows every key they issued — instantly, with no cleanup.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Append-only. Every credential change, permission change, and administrative action.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Workspace policy. Changes marked hot take effect immediately; the rest need a restart.
settings.restartNeeded: These settings need a restart to take effect: {keys}
settings.accessTitle: Administrator access to knowledge base content

break_glass.label: Break-glass (recommended)
break_glass.detail: Administrators manage knowledge bases but cannot read their content without opening a time-boxed, reasoned window. The grant is audited and the owner is notified.

on_grant.label: On explicit grant
on_grant.detail: Administrators read content only where a knowledge base owner has granted it to them directly.

always.label: Always
always.detail: Administrators can read every knowledge base's content. Appropriate for a single-team deployment; a compliance problem for a shared one.

settings.queuesHint: Oldest-ready age is the signal that matters — depth alone can look healthy while one task sits behind a saturated workspace.

errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check that Cairn is running.
